bug_semantics: Traefik ForwardAuth always buffers the authentication server HTTP response body in memory with no size cap. In ServeHTTP it did `body, readError := ioutil.ReadAll(forwardResponse.Body)` (later `io.ReadAll` after the Go 1.16 ioutil migration; v2.11.37 `pkg/middlewares/auth/forward.go:128`, v3.6.8 line 211). The body is required because a non-2xx auth response is copied back to the client. An auth server that returns a large or infinite chunked body can force Traefik to allocate until OOM, taking down every route on the process. CWE-770. Request-body forwarding later gained `maxBodySize`; the response-body path had no equivalent until the 2026 patch.
